actions.reasoning: Domain appears suspicious: legitimate ADP employee portal uses subdomains of adp.com (e.g., workforcenow.adp.com or workforce.adp.com). This domain uses a hyphenated hostname with adp.com placed after a dash (workforcenow-adp.com), which is a common typosquatting/phishing pattern. The site may impersonate ADP and requesting bank account/routing (high-sensitivity PII) here would be unsafe.
